sections.changelog: v1.2.101: Polished Studio surfaces with lean MV-styled scrollbars, hardened Media Studio grid sizing, folder membership refresh fixes, sub-folder parent support, batch deselect and in-modal new collection assignment, cleaner asset collection membership UI, branded media rename confirmation, and clearer replace/convert actions. Improved Content Studio grouping, group visibility toggles, MV-styled selects/checkboxes, status action hints, and in-studio content editing. Added the first Plugin Studio surface for activation, deactivation, auto-update toggles, updates, and inactive plugin deletion, restored CSS Studio workspace sizing, and replaced copied shortcut letters with MV-owned Phosphor icon buttons.
